##Combine outcome an dfeatures
```{r}
library(sf); library(dplyr)

## Load spatial outcome and features
root <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois"

outcome_sf <- readRDS(file.path(root, "Data/LS_outcome_all_data_sf.rds"))
features <- read.csv(file.path(root, "Data/Faetures/ALL FEATURES COMBINED.csv"))

## Standardize county names for joining
clean_county <- function(x) toupper(gsub("[^A-Z0-9]", "", trimws(x)))

outcome_sf <- outcome_sf %>% mutate(join_key = clean_county(COUNTY_NAM))
features <- features %>% mutate(join_key = clean_county(COUNTY_NAM))

## Check county matching before joining
cat("Outcome counties:", nrow(outcome_sf), "\n")
cat("Feature counties:", nrow(features), "\n")
cat("Unmatched outcome counties:", sum(!outcome_sf$join_key %in% features$join_key), "\n")
cat("Unmatched feature counties:", sum(!features$join_key %in% outcome_sf$join_key), "\n")

## Join all features to complete spatial/outcome data
all_data <- outcome_sf %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    features %>% dplyr::select(-COUNTY_NAM),
    by="join_key"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-join_key)


print(all_data)

## Remove unnecessary columns and retain one county-name column
all_data <- all_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -total_coun, -is_count, -aa_count, -dv_count,
    -county_key, -COUNTY
  )

## Check
cat("Counties:", nrow(all_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(all_data), "\n")
names(all_data)


```



## Feature screening
```{r}
## Feature screening
vars <- c("BIO2","BIO8","BIO9","BIO15","BIO18",
          "Forest_pct","Wetland_pct","Forest_edge_density","Deer_suitability")

x <- sf::st_drop_geometry(all_data) %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars))

## Descriptive statistics
feature_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable=vars,
  Missing=sapply(x, function(z) sum(is.na(z))),
  Mean=sapply(x, mean, na.rm=TRUE),
  SD=sapply(x, sd, na.rm=TRUE),
  Median=sapply(x, median, na.rm=TRUE),
  Q1=sapply(x, quantile, 0.25, na.rm=TRUE),
  Q3=sapply(x, quantile, 0.75, na.rm=TRUE),
  Minimum=sapply(x, min, na.rm=TRUE),
  Maximum=sapply(x, max, na.rm=TRUE)
)

feature_summary[,-1] <- round(feature_summary[,-1], 3)
print(feature_summary)

## Pearson correlation matrix
corr <- cor(x, use="complete.obs", method="pearson")
print(round(corr, 2))

## Flag correlations |r| >= 0.70
idx <- which(abs(corr) >= 0.70 & upper.tri(corr), arr.ind=TRUE)

high_corr <- data.frame(
  Variable_1=rownames(corr)[idx[,1]],
  Variable_2=colnames(corr)[idx[,2]],
  Pearson_r=round(corr[idx], 3)
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(Pearson_r)))

print(high_corr)

## VIF for all 9 predictors
vif_values <- sapply(vars, function(v) {
  fit <- lm(reformulate(setdiff(vars,v), response=v), data=x)
  1/(1-summary(fit)$r.squared)
})

vif_table <- data.frame(
  Variable=names(vif_values),
  VIF=round(as.numeric(vif_values), 2)
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(VIF))

print(vif_table)

```


##Retain predictors after correlation screening
```{r}
## Recalculate VIF after removing forest edge density
vars8 <- c("BIO2","BIO8","BIO9","BIO15","BIO18",
           "Forest_pct","Wetland_pct","Deer_suitability")

x8 <- sf::st_drop_geometry(all_data) %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars8))

vif8 <- sapply(vars8, function(v) {
  fit <- lm(reformulate(setdiff(vars8,v), response=v), data=x8)
  1/(1-summary(fit)$r.squared)
})

vif8_table <- data.frame(
  Variable=names(vif8),
  VIF=round(as.numeric(vif8),2)
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(VIF))

print(vif8_table)

```


##Ploting all corelations and VIF
```{r}
## Plotting all correlations and VIF
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(grid)

## Predictor sets
vars9 <- c("BIO2","BIO8","BIO9","BIO15","BIO18",
           "Forest_pct","Wetland_pct","Forest_edge_density","Deer_suitability")

vars8 <- c("BIO2","BIO8","BIO9","BIO15","BIO18",
           "Forest_pct","Wetland_pct","Deer_suitability")

labels9 <- c("BIO2","BIO8","BIO9","BIO15","BIO18",
             "Forest","Wetland","Forest edge density","Deer suitability")

labels8 <- c("BIO2","BIO8","BIO9","BIO15","BIO18",
             "Forest","Wetland","Deer suitability")

## Correlation data
x9 <- sf::st_drop_geometry(all_data) %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars9))

x8 <- sf::st_drop_geometry(all_data) %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars8))

names(x9) <- labels9
names(x8) <- labels8

corr9 <- cor(x9, method="pearson", use="complete.obs")
corr8 <- cor(x8, method="pearson", use="complete.obs")

## Common heatmap theme
corr_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x=element_text(size=11, face="bold", color="black",
                             angle=45, hjust=1),
    axis.text.y=element_text(size=11, face="bold", color="black"),
    panel.grid=element_blank(),
    panel.background=element_rect(fill="white", color=NA),
    plot.background=element_rect(fill="white", color=NA),
    legend.title=element_text(size=11, face="bold"),
    legend.text=element_text(size=10)
  )

## All 9 candidate predictors
corr_plot9 <- ggcorrplot(
  corr9, method="square", type="lower", hc.order=FALSE,
  lab=TRUE, lab_size=3.5, show.diag=FALSE,
  colors=c("#313695","white","#A50026"),
  outline.color="white"
) +
  labs(x=NULL, y=NULL, fill="Pearson r") +
  corr_theme +
  guides(fill=guide_colorbar(barheight=unit(5,"cm"),
                             barwidth=unit(0.6,"cm")))

print(corr_plot9)

## Final 8 retained predictors
corr_plot8 <- ggcorrplot(
  corr8, method="square", type="lower", hc.order=FALSE,
  lab=TRUE, lab_size=3.5, show.diag=FALSE,
  colors=c("#313695","white","#A50026"),
  outline.color="white"
) +
  labs(x=NULL, y=NULL, fill="Pearson r") +
  corr_theme +
  guides(fill=guide_colorbar(barheight=unit(5,"cm"),
                             barwidth=unit(0.6,"cm")))

print(corr_plot8)

## VIF for final 8 predictors
vif_values <- sapply(vars8, function(v) {
  fit <- lm(reformulate(setdiff(vars8,v), response=v),
            data=sf::st_drop_geometry(all_data))
  1/(1-summary(fit)$r.squared)
})

vif_df <- data.frame(
  Variable=labels8,
  VIF=as.numeric(vif_values)
) %>%
  arrange(VIF) %>%
  mutate(Variable=factor(Variable, levels=Variable))

vif_plot <- ggplot(vif_df, aes(x=Variable, y=VIF)) +
  geom_col(width=0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=5, linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.05))) +
  labs(x=NULL, y="Variance inflation factor (VIF)") +
  theme_classic(base_size=13) +
  theme(
    axis.text=element_text(color="black"),
    axis.title=element_text(face="bold")
  )

print(vif_plot)

## Save
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Output"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"correlation_all_9_candidate_predictors.tiff"),
       corr_plot9, width=9, height=8, dpi=600,
       compression="lzw", bg="white")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"correlation_final_8_predictors.tiff"),
       corr_plot8, width=9, height=8, dpi=600,
       compression="lzw", bg="white")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"VIF_final_8_predictors.tiff"),
       vif_plot, width=7, height=5.5, dpi=600,
       compression="lzw", bg="white")
```


##Map all features retained

```{r}
## Mapping final retained predictors

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)

## Use all_data already created above
stopifnot(nrow(all_data) == 102)

## Base theme - similar to previous figure
my_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

## Climate
p1 <- ggplot(all_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = BIO2), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "BIO2\n(Mean Diurnal Range)",
    option = "plasma", na.value = "transparent",
    guide = guide_colorbar(direction = "horizontal", barwidth = unit(6, "cm"),
                           barheight = unit(0.6, "cm"), title.position = "top")
  ) +
  ggtitle("Temperature 1") +
  my_theme

p3 <- ggplot(all_data) +

p4 <- ggplot(all_data) +

    option = "plasma", na.value = "transparent",

p5 <- ggplot(all_data) +
```
